status_semantics.DIFFERENT: Captured native/reference metric states or values differ; no parity/equivalence is claimed.
status_semantics.EXACT: Captured native/reference metric states and values are equal; this is a value comparison only.
status_semantics.UNVERIFIED: The reference metric is absent/unverified, the native metric is incomplete, or occurrence identity cannot be compared; no equality is claimed.

native_identity.note: The captures identify only the replay executable path; they do not record a commit, build, binary digest, host, timestamp, or toolchain.

rules: Repository checkout prefixes are replaced with <REPOSITORY> (both the hoostack/hoonarqube and direct hoonarqube layouts).

repository_identity.note: The captures do not record a repository commit; do not substitute the current checkout HEAD.

unavailable_provenance: The native executable commit/build identity was not recorded in the captures; the replay path is not an identity claim.
The native executable SHA-256 was not recorded in the captures.
